definitions.explanation: Causing no harm, injury, or damage. Used for substances, animals, actions, or people that pose no danger.

examples.japanese: この{虫|むし}は{無害|むがい}です。
{人体|じんたい}に{無害|むがい}な{成分|せいぶん}で{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: It is made from ingredients that are harmless to the human body.

examples.japanese: この{化学物質|かがくぶっしつ}は{環境|かんきょう}に{無害|むがい}であることが{実験|じっけん}で{確認|かくにん}されている。
examples.english: It has been confirmed through experiments that this chemical substance is harmless to the environment.

notes:
A compound of {無|む} (without; non-) and {害|がい} (harm; damage). Functions as a na-adjective with な (e.g., {無害|むがい}な) and as a noun. Commonly used with に to specify what something is harmless to.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人体|じんたい}に{無害|むがい}: harmless to the human body
- {環境|かんきょう}に{無害|むがい}: environmentally harmless
- {無害|むがい}な{物質|ぶっしつ}: a harmless substance
- {無害|むがい}な{生物|せいぶつ}: a harmless organism
- {無害|むがい}{化|か}: rendering harmless; detoxification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有害|ゆうがい}: harmful; toxic — the direct antonym
- {安全|あんぜん}: safe — broader term covering freedom from all danger, not just absence of harm
- {無毒|むどく}: nontoxic; nonvenomous — specifically about absence of poison or venom
